scientific_integrity: Exact analytical proof supported by an independently assembled finite joint Markov generator and rational symbolic checks; no empirical data or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Single binary habitat patch, strictly positive constant colonization/extinction rates in each autonomous Markov environmental state; common scaling of environment-only rates. Three-regime witness uses all-to-all symmetric environmental transitions. No field-data validation or assertion about arbitrary ecological responses.
title: Three environmental regimes are necessary for an interior optimum in stationary patch occupancy
